title: Old agreement with non-human beings from the Truman–Eisenhower era

tellings.quote: that that is the nature of at least one very old agreement um sometime in the Truman and Eisenhower era uh that was arrived at.

plain: A former Pentagon official turned whistleblower named Matthew Brown says that a very old agreement was reached with non-human beings sometime in the era of Presidents Harry Truman and Dwight Eisenhower, roughly 1945 to 1961. He passes this on as something he was told rather than something he saw, and says it shaped "the nature of at least one very old agreement." If true, it would mean the US government struck a deal with non-human beings decades ago.
